verdict.rationale: gstack is distributed as a git repo of skills and supports both global and vendored (project-local) installs, so a team can share it through a repo or vendor it into the project, and the upgrade skill handles both install types. However, no evidence documents an explicit team-distribution or committed-files workflow, and a community commenter warns the git-clone-and-copy model may struggle when repos need divergent review or QA flows. Missing for 10: documented team/shared-repo distribution workflow, explicit guidance on committing skills to a project for teammates, a first-party marketplace or registry, and independent corroboration of team-scale use.
